notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds on Exhibit D are governmental (School Nutrition is a special revenue fund here), so no business-type section. Exhibit D Total Major Governmental Funds column used (p4). Local Sources, County Sources, State Sources, Federal Sources and Non-Revenue Receipts were split using the per-fund schedules (Exhibits F-K, p5-11); splits tie exactly to each printed Exhibit D line. Property tax split total 1,884,285 and interest 7,633 agree with Exhibit B (p2). Operation & Maintenance of Plant (874,505) split by fund column into General 423,488 (support services) and Special Building 451,017 (capital outlay). Interfund loan of 289,066 (General repayment / Special Building receipt) nets to zero in Exhibit D and is recorded only in the fund detail schedules as other financing. Investments 33,499 and cash with fiscal agent 316,117 are included in the 739,438 cash balance. General Fund total receipts on Exhibit F (4,532,823) include transfers in 375,541 and loan proceeds 200,000, flagged via includes. Depreciation Fund prints no total receipts or disbursements line, so no detail_totals for it; flex funding (3166) and 3599 had no actual. Employee Benefit fund printed expenditure is an unlabeled subtotal 8,326. Read pages 1-11 of 11.
